prompt:
Create EIGHT blueprint line-art cards in a 3x3 layout, first eight positions occupied in reading order, last bottom-right position EMPTY transparent. Reference1 is the exact 8 target objects, same order, silhouettes, composition and angles. Reference2 is the previous completed blueprint sheet: match its card color, rounded corners, faint grid, thin WHITE linework and overall rendering. Do NOT copy reference2's objects.

Square sheet. All eight cards same square dimensions and corner radius. Deep teal-blue around #17627d, very faint low-contrast square graph-paper grid. Generous equal gutters and outer margins, transparent outside the cards. No card shadow. Ninth slot has NO card, NO grid, no marks, fully transparent.
Center each entire object group in its card. Keep the whole object within the central 65% of card with at least 17.5% breathing room on each side, especially right side. Shrink complex objects to fit. Objects do not touch edges.
ONLY THIN UNIFORM WHITE LINE ART. No colored fills, no solid white filled surfaces, no shading, no gradients, no colored highlights, no hatching. Grid/card color shows through every object surface. Cute simplified cartoon game-item blueprint, not complex mechanical drawings. Same fine line weight as reference2. 
Absolutely NO added dimension lines, arrows, measurement ticks, corner brackets, registration marks, labels, letters, numbers, words or decoration outside the objects. Only the object's own pictograms may be depicted in fine white outlines. Do not add text.

EXACT ORDER:
1 top-left SECURITY CAMERA: same wall-mounted dome camera, mount plate behind at left, round dome lens, housing seam and small indicator; unfilled outlines including lens rings, no white highlight dots.
2 top-middle AIR PURIFIER: rounded tower, circular fan grille on front, little light, vertical front vent slots and side vents, two curved airflow shapes rising from top as in reference. All airflow marks belong to object, keep within margins, outline only.
3 top-right SMART BAND: loop wristband with rounded rectangular display containing heartbeat zigzag, three strap holes, side retaining band. Same tilt/perspective.
4 middle-left SMART FRIDGE: two-door cream fridge converted to white outlines, two long handles, little screen with outlined bowl pictogram, same 3/4 angle, tiny feet.
5 middle-middle SMART WATERING: pot, two sprouts, bent irrigation pipe over pot, ONE falling water drop, small soil sensor; preserve exact layout. No filled leaves or soil, only contours.
6 middle-right SMART WASHER: same front-loading washer with round door, little dial and T-shirt screen icon, same perspective. White outline of shirt, not solid white shirt.
7 bottom-left SPELL CHECKER: open notebook and diagonal pencil at right, one wavy abstract line circled on page; preserve composition. The wavy line is NOT text. Draw circle, pencil, notebook as fine white outlines.
8 bottom-middle STUDY HELPER: tablet with support stand and single lightbulb screen pictogram, same tilt and 3/4 view. Outline bulb and small rays, no fills.
9 bottom-right NOTHING — fully empty transparent.

Keep only requested eight objects, one centered item group per card, NO diagram annotations. Faithful shapes/angles from reference1, blueprint card style from reference2.
